Craft a Thermite Torch from HBM Thermite Powder, an Unlit Torch, and a Matchbox. Place it, light it, and it burns at 2000°C for 10 minutes.

The torch welds metal blocks together, seals pressurized rooms, and ignites anything flammable within 3 blocks. It also emits a 20-block light radius. Use it for airlock sealing: place on the inner surface of the airlock door and light it to weld all metal blocks within 3 blocks into a single airtight structure.

§cWARNING:§f The torch can't be extinguished once lit. Not even water. Place it far from wooden structures or use a Force Field Projector (10092) to contain the fire. It will set the player on fire too.

The torch is consumed on use. The Thermite Torch is also a prerequisite for the Planetary Engineering and Volcanic Planet Mission chains.
